title: A database to support the evaluation of gender biases in GPT-4o output

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating explicit biases through direct open-ended questioning and explicit trait-to-gender categorization tasks, as well as assessing implicit biases using a text-based adaptation of the Implicit Association Test (IAT) that tracks categorization errors across stereotypical and anti-stereotypical gender-trait pairings (including male, female, and non-binary categories).
